learning_objective: 🎯 We will look at a beautiful big picture and learn to name all the fun things we see!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Pictures tell us a story without using any words. We have to look closely like a detective to find everything.
When we see a picture we can talk about the colours people and animals in it. It is so much fun to share what we see!

fun_activity.title: 🔍 Be a Picture Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Open a storybook and pick any picture you like. Point to three things and name them loudly in English!

quick_recap: ⭐ Pictures have many hidden things for us to find.
⭐ We use our eyes to look and our mouth to talk about the picture.
⭐ Finding new things makes picture reading a fun game.
